Subject: Clarify order form commercial mechanics (commits / tax / PO)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the draft order form — a couple of items Finance needs clarified before we can route to procurement:

- Pricing schedule: our procurement team wants the minimum commit split documented explicitly (we prefer quarterly drawdown rather than a single upfront prepayment). Can Redwood support quarterly billing against a committed annual spend?
- Net terms: does Redwood accept Net 30 or Net 45? Our standard is Net 30, but we can make exceptions for one-time onboarding fees.
- Taxes & VAT: OptiScale is VAT-registered in the EU and has a US entity for domestic spend. Who is responsible for VAT/GST on hosted usage? Will Redwood invoice gross and remit, or should we self-report?
- PO routing: please confirm invoice remit-to email and whether a PO number is required for payment to proceed.

Can you share a marked-up order form showing the proposed quarterly split and how tax fields will appear on invoices? Also include any standard language Redwood requires for tax certificates.

Olivia

Subject: Re: Clarify order form commercial mechanics (commits / tax / PO)

Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then I've attached a marked-up order form with my proposed commercial language.

- Quarterly drawdown: yes, Redwood can structure the minimum annual commit as four equal quarterly invoices (invoice issued on day 1 of each quarter against the annual committed pool, with consumption debited). We call this a "Quarterly Commit Drawdown" on the Order Form.
- Net terms: standard is Net 45 for dedicated/commercial deals; I'm open to Net 30 on the condition that the first quarter invoice is paid at signature or we accept a PO + Net 30 for the first quarter. Happy to have Finance coordinates on that.
- Taxes/VAT: Redwood typically invoices gross (including applicable VAT/sales tax) and remits per jurisdiction, unless the customer provides a valid tax-exemption certificate that we accept. For EU VAT-registered customers with a valid VAT number, we can zero-rate certain intra-EU supplies but require the VAT number and an invoice field noting VAT reverse-charge where applicable.
- PO routing: please send PO numbers to optiscale-finance@optiscale.com. Invoice remit-to will be optiscale-finance@optiscale.com — Redwood will also mail PDF copies to billing@redwoodinference.com for records. Please confirm the exact billing address you want on the invoice.

Attachments: Aditya_Redlines_OrderForm.docx (I redlined the Commit Schedule and added a Tax section with example invoice line items).

Next steps: Laura (legal) and Karthik (Sales Ops) are cc'd — Laura, can you review the tax wording and PO acceptance language? Karthik, I'll need final approval on the billing cadence.

Aditya / Olivia — quick legal notes on tax + PO language. I'm pasting the key suggested clauses so they can be dropped into the order form.

1) Taxes — proposed clause: "Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Customer shall be responsible for all taxes, duties, or government fees (excluding Redwood's income taxes) arising from Customer's purchase of Services. Redwood will invoice gross for applicable indirect taxes (VAT/GST/sales tax) and remit to the relevant taxing authority. If Customer provides an acceptable tax-exemption certificate or valid VAT registration information where applicable, Redwood will apply tax treatment consistent with such documentation (e.g., reverse charge)."

2) Withholding — add: "If Customer is required by applicable law to withhold taxes on any amount payable to Redwood, Customer shall provide Redwood with official documentation of the withholding and pay an additional amount so that Redwood receives the same net amount as if no withholding had occurred (i.e., gross-up)."

3) PO acceptance — do NOT make issuance of a PO a condition precedent to Redwood's obligations. Suggested: "A Customer PO is for Customer tracking only and will not modify, terminate, or supersede the Order Form unless agreed in writing by the parties. Redwood will accept invoices referencing a PO number and will not refuse to invoice or delay performance solely because a PO has not been received."

Operational notes: if Olivia confirms quarterly drawdown + Net 45 (or Net 30 for first quarter), Sales Ops (Karthik) should set up invoice templates to include a discrete "Tax Certificate Provided: Yes/No" field so Finance can track.

Let me know if OptiScale needs a different approach for EU VAT reverse-charge (we can add optional language).

Laura Bennett

Thanks Laura — that language looks straightforward. A couple follow-ups from Finance: 

- We can accept Net 45 for the term if Redwood agrees to Net 30 for the first quarter invoice or Redwood secures a one-time credit holdback until PO issuance. Prefer Net 30 first quarter + Net 45 thereafter.
- For VAT: OptiScale will provide its EU VAT registration number and an electronic copy of the certificate if needed. We will also provide a US exemption certificate where applicable. Please add a field on the invoice: "Customer Tax Doc Provided: [Yes/No] - Document ID". That will be used by our AP team.
- PO routing: we'll issue a PO but per Laura's suggested clause we understand it doesn't change the order form terms. PO will be sent to optiscale-finance@optiscale.com and cc'd to procurement@optiscale.com.

Please send the DocuSign link to the final order form and we'll return a PO number within 48 hours of signature.

Olivia — thanks, all. Attached is the Final Order Form for signature (OrderForm_Final_for_Signature.pdf) and the DocuSign URL is included below. Summary of agreed commercial points: 

- Commit cadence: Annual committed amount billed as four equal quarterly invoices (Quarterly Commit Drawdown). Consumption will debit the committed pool; overages billed monthly.
- Net terms: Net 30 for the first quarter invoice; Net 45 thereafter.
- Taxes: Redwood will invoice gross for applicable indirect taxes and remit where required. OptiScale will provide VAT/GST registration numbers and any exemption documents; invoices will include a "Customer Tax Doc Provided: Yes/No - Document ID" field. For intra-EU supplies where reverse-charge applies, invoice will include the reverse-charge notation and VAT number.
- PO: Redwood will accept invoices referencing a Customer PO but issuance of a PO is not a condition precedent to performance or payment under the Order Form. Please send PO numbers to optiscale-finance@optiscale.com; billing copies will be sent to billing@redwoodinference.com for reconciliation.
